'''epyons_anger Invasion and Podracing-Droids Coming to Town''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[epyons_anger]]
* '''Published:''' 6 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion epyons_anger DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Invasion, with Podracing for Retrieval

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

I've found this deck works best by setting up on Naboo and draining, not necessarily from flipping the objective. The Ghhhks help with early drains, and all of the Naboo sites drain for 2.

The podracing and After Her help with retrieval, as well as First Strike if you can manage to be very offensive.

The Nemoidians at the throne room with Guri, or Guri in space help with limiting opponent's destiny, as does the flip slide of the objective.

If this deck sets up fast, IE good opening hand with some droids and Ghhhks, then the game is easy, if not, you may have to take some drains until you can set up.
